single_window: Open all URLs in single window
tip_drag: TIP: Select an app to edit its settings
paste_path: Paste a full path or choose a file with Browse
help_instructions:
Add an application to a profile

  1. Choose a profile in the main window and click EDIT, or create a new profile.
  2. Click ADD FILE and choose an application (.exe) or shortcut (.lnk).
  3. To paste a path, right-click the desktop shortcut and choose Copy as path (on Windows 11 this may be under Show more options). Return to the editor, click the FULL PATH field, and press Ctrl+V. Surrounding quotes are fine. You can also click BROWSE and select the file.
  4. To open websites, select the browser, enable This is a browser, add the URLs, and click SAVE.
  5. Select the profile in the main window and click CREATE .BAT. Double-click the generated file to launch the programs.

If Run as administrator is enabled, Windows will ask you to confirm.
